objectives: 介紹月球的來源、演化歷史、從表層道內核的物質性質和構造，以及與星際空間環境的作用
content:
1. Origin of the Moon
1.1 Giant impact scenarios
1.2 Post-impact evolution
2. Surface evolution
2.1 Lunar magma ocean
2.2 Crustal evolution
2.3 Regolith ＆ mega-regolith
3. Structure and evolution of the lunar interior
4. Lunar impact features and processes
Crater morphology
Cratering dynamics
5. Cratering chronology
Size frequency distributions
Dating
6. Volcanism and tectonics
7. Magnetism
8. Solar wind interaction/space weathering
9. Dust and atmosphere
10. Lunar water and volatiles
